description: Time-series observations for one series over a date range. Pass a series ID and a from/to window (dates YYYY-MM-DD). Returns an array of {date, value}. Example: seriesId "SEKEURPMI" gives the daily EUR/SEK exchange-rate fixing; "SECBREPOEFF" gives the Riksbank policy rate. Use list_series to discover IDs.
name: get_observations
title: Get Observations
